            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }

            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative {
                display: none;
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root {
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem);
            }
            .grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html {
                scroll-behavior: auto;
            }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS — Staggered reveal on slide enter
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .slide.visible .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.65s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-40px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        /* Bar chart bars animate width from 0 */
        .bar-fill {
            width: 0 !important;
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .bar-fill {
            width: var(--target-width) !important;
        }

        /* Counter animation uses JS */
        .count-up { display: inline-block; }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL TYPOGRAPHY & BASE
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: var(--bg-dark);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION — Progress bar + nav dots
           Swiss Modern: thin red bar top
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            z-index: 1000;
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 0.3s var(--ease-in-out);
        }

        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(5px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            height: clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
            border: none;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE COUNTER (top-right)
           =========================================== */
        .slide-counter {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            right: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .slide-counter.light { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           Dark panel, large Archivo Black title, red accent line
           =========================================== */
        .slide-title {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .title-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .title-overline {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-light);
            letter-spacing: 0.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
            display: inline-block;
            align-self: start;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
        }

        .title-main {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
        }

        .title-h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5.5vw, 5rem);
            color: var(--text-light);
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            max-width: 16ch;
        }

        .title-h1 em {
            color: var(--accent-light);
            font-style: normal;
        }

        .title-subtitle {
            font-family: var(--font-accent);
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.6vw, 1.2rem);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
            font-weight: 400;
            max-width: 55ch;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-end;
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            padding-top: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .title-source {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .title-audience {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
            text-align: right;
        }

        /* Decorative grid lines in title background */
        .title-grid-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px) clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Red corner accent */
        .title-corner-accent {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            right: 0;
            width: clamp(80px, 15vw, 200px);
            height: clamp(80px, 15vw, 200px);
            background: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.08;
            clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE HEADER — shared across content slides
           =========================================== */
        .slide-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem) var(--slide-padding) 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .slide-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .slide-eyebrow.on-dark { color: var(--accent-light); }

        .slide-title-text {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            max-width: 32ch;
        }

        .slide-title-text.on-dark { color: var(--text-light); }

        .slide-rule {
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            margin: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem) 0;
            width: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: VACCINE TIMELINE ACCELERATION
           Horizontal bar chart — dark background
           =========================================== */
        .slide-timeline { background: var(--bg-dark); }

        .timeline-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            padding: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .timeline-header {
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem) var(--slide-padding) 0;
        }

        .timeline-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.8vh, 0.9rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem) var(--slide-padding);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(80px, 14vw, 160px) 1fr clamp(40px, 5vw, 70px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        .bar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .bar-track {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            border-radius: 2px;
            height: clamp(14px, 2.5vh, 32px);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            transition: width 1.0s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .bar-fill.highlight {
            background: var(--accent-light);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 51, 0, 0.6);
        }

        .bar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            text-align: left;
        }

        .bar-value.highlight-val { color: var(--accent-light); }

        .timeline-note {
            font-family: var(--font-accent);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: US DISEASE ELIMINATION — Table
           White background, precise grid, red/green coding
           =========================================== */
        .slide-elimination { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .table-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .data-table-wrap {
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .data-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
        }

        .data-table th {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: right;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--text-primary);
        }

        .data-table th:first-child { text-align: left; }

        .data-table td {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vh, 0.55rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: right;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .data-table td:first-child {
            text-align: left;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .data-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

        .badge-100 {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--data-green);
            color: white;
            font-size: calc(var(--label-size) * 0.95);
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 2px clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 7px);
            border-radius: 3px;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }

        .badge-partial {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--data-amber);
            color: white;
            font-size: calc(var(--label-size) * 0.95);
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 2px clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 7px);
            border-radius: 3px;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }

        .table-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem) var(--slide-padding);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: MEASLES HEATMAP (US States)
           Dark background, simulated heatmap visualization
           =========================================== */
        .slide-measles { background: var(--bg-dark); }

        .measles-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .heatmap-container {
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding);
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .heatmap-eras {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 3fr 2fr 3fr 2fr 3fr;
            gap: 0;
            height: clamp(120px, 28vh, 260px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .era-block {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .era-pre { background: #8b1a00; }
        .era-div1 { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-left: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-right: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
        .era-vaccine { background: #5b2a00; }
        .era-div2 { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-left: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-right: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
        .era-mandate { background: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

        .era-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .era-range {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .era-incidence {
            font-family: var(--font-accent);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
            margin-top: 6px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .milestone-arrow {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }

        .measles-milestones {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .milestone-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
        }

        .milestone-year {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--accent-light);
        }

        .milestone-desc {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
            margin-top: 2px;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: SMALLPOX ERADICATION
           White background, timeline visualization
           =========================================== */
        .slide-smallpox { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .smallpox-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .eradication-timeline {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding);
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.6rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .timeline-spine {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0;
        }

        .timeline-event {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px) 20px 1fr;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .t-year {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.6vw, 1.1rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .t-node {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .t-dot {
            width: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 14px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 14px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .t-dot.major {
            background: var(--text-primary);
            border: 3px solid var(--accent);
        }

        .t-line {
            flex: 1;
            width: 2px;
            background: var(--border);
            min-height: clamp(12px, 2.5vh, 28px);
        }

        .t-text {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem) 0;
        }

        .t-text strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            display: block;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
        }

        .smallpox-factors {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .factor-chip {
            background: var(--accent-pale);
            border: 1px solid rgba(204, 34, 0, 0.2);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .factor-chip strong {
            color: var(--accent);
            display: block;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: HERD IMMUNITY MECHANISM
           Dark background, diagram illustration
           =========================================== */
        .slide-herd { background: #0a0a0a; }

        .herd-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .herd-diagram {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .herd-panel {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
        }

        .herd-panel-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .herd-panel-title.active-title { color: var(--text-light); }

        /* Population grid of people icons */
        .population-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(3px, 0.5vw, 8px);
        }

        .person-icon {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        .person-head {
            width: clamp(10px, 1.8vw, 22px);
            height: clamp(10px, 1.8vw, 22px);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .person-body {
            width: clamp(8px, 1.4vw, 18px);
            height: clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 28px);
            border-radius: 4px 4px 6px 6px;
        }

        /* Person state colors */
        .p-vaccinated .person-head { background: #4ade80; }
        .p-vaccinated .person-body { background: #16a34a; }
        .p-unvaccinated .person-head { background: #fbbf24; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           Swiss Modern — keyboard + touch + scroll navigation
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.total = this.slides.length;
                this.current = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupMouseWheel();
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            /* Intersection Observer — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.current = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.6 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
                });
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.total) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            goTo(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'PageDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.current + 1);
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.current - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.total - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                let startX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    const threshold = 50;

                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > threshold) {
                        this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupMouseWheel() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    this.goTo(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }
        }

        /* Boot on DOM ready */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
            /* Trigger first slide immediately */
            document.querySelector('.slide')?.classList.add('visible');
        });

        /* Also trigger first slide in case DOMContentLoaded already fired */
        if (document.readyState !== 'loading') {
            document.querySelector('.slide')?.classList.add('visible');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        }

        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(5px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            height: clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
            border: none;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE COUNTER (top-right)
           =========================================== */
        .slide-counter {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            right: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .slide-counter.light { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           Dark panel, large Archivo Black title, red accent line
           =========================================== */
        .slide-title {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .title-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .title-overline {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-light);
            letter-spacing: 0.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
            display: inline-block;
            align-self: start;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
        }

        .title-main {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
        }

        .title-h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5.5vw, 5rem);
            color: var(--text-light);
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            max-width: 16ch;
        }

        .title-h1 em {
            color: var(--accent-light);
            font-style: normal;
        }

        .title-subtitle {
            font-family: var(--font-accent);
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.6vw, 1.2rem);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
            font-weight: 400;
            max-width: 55ch;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-end;
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            padding-top: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .title-source {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .title-audience {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
            text-align: right;
        }

        /* Decorative grid lines in title background */
        .title-grid-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px) clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* Red corner accent */
        .title-corner-accent {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            right: 0;
            width: clamp(80px, 15vw, 200px);
            height: clamp(80px, 15vw, 200px);
            background: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.08;
            clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE HEADER — shared across content slides
           =========================================== */
        .slide-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem) var(--slide-padding) 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .slide-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .slide-eyebrow.on-dark { color: var(--accent-light); }

        .slide-title-text {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            max-width: 32ch;
        }

        .slide-title-text.on-dark { color: var(--text-light); }

        .slide-rule {
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            margin: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem) 0;
            width: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: VACCINE TIMELINE ACCELERATION
           Horizontal bar chart — dark background
           =========================================== */
        .slide-timeline { background: var(--bg-dark); }

        .timeline-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            padding: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .timeline-header {
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem) var(--slide-padding) 0;
        }

        .timeline-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 0.8vh, 0.9rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem) var(--slide-padding);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(80px, 14vw, 160px) 1fr clamp(40px, 5vw, 70px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        .bar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .bar-track {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            border-radius: 2px;
            height: clamp(14px, 2.5vh, 32px);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            transition: width 1.0s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .bar-fill.highlight {
            background: var(--accent-light);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 51, 0, 0.6);
        }

        .bar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            text-align: left;
        }

        .bar-value.highlight-val { color: var(--accent-light); }

        .timeline-note {
            font-family: var(--font-accent);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: US DISEASE ELIMINATION — Table
           White background, precise grid, red/green coding
           =========================================== */
        .slide-elimination { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .table-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .data-table-wrap {
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .data-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
        }

        .data-table th {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: right;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--text-primary);
        }

        .data-table th:first-child { text-align: left; }

        .data-table td {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vh, 0.55rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: right;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        .data-table td:first-child {
            text-align: left;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .data-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

        .badge-100 {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--data-green);
            color: white;
            font-size: calc(var(--label-size) * 0.95);
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 2px clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 7px);
            border-radius: 3px;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }

        .badge-partial {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--data-amber);
            color: white;
            font-size: calc(var(--label-size) * 0.95);
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 2px clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 7px);
            border-radius: 3px;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }

        .table-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem) var(--slide-padding);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: MEASLES HEATMAP (US States)
           Dark background, simulated heatmap visualization
           =========================================== */
        .slide-measles { background: var(--bg-dark); }

        .measles-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .heatmap-container {
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding);
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .heatmap-eras {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 3fr 2fr 3fr 2fr 3fr;
            gap: 0;
            height: clamp(120px, 28vh, 260px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .era-block {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .era-pre { background: #8b1a00; }
        .era-div1 { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-left: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-right: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
        .era-vaccine { background: #5b2a00; }
        .era-div2 { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-left: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-right: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
        .era-mandate { background: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

        .era-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .era-range {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .era-incidence {
            font-family: var(--font-accent);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
            margin-top: 6px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .milestone-arrow {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }

        .measles-milestones {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .milestone-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
        }

        .milestone-year {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--accent-light);
        }

        .milestone-desc {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
            margin-top: 2px;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: SMALLPOX ERADICATION
           White background, timeline visualization
           =========================================== */
        .slide-smallpox { background: var(--bg-primary); }

        .smallpox-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .eradication-timeline {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding);
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.6rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .timeline-spine {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0;
        }

        .timeline-event {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px) 20px 1fr;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .t-year {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.6vw, 1.1rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .t-node {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .t-dot {
            width: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 14px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 14px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .t-dot.major {
            background: var(--text-primary);
            border: 3px solid var(--accent);
        }

        .t-line {
            flex: 1;
            width: 2px;
            background: var(--border);
            min-height: clamp(12px, 2.5vh, 28px);
        }

        .t-text {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem) 0;
        }

        .t-text strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            display: block;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
        }

        .smallpox-factors {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .factor-chip {
            background: var(--accent-pale);
            border: 1px solid rgba(204, 34, 0, 0.2);
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.7rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .factor-chip strong {
            color: var(--accent);
            display: block;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: HERD IMMUNITY MECHANISM
           Dark background, diagram illustration
           =========================================== */
        .slide-herd { background: #0a0a0a; }

        .herd-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .herd-diagram {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .herd-panel {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
        }

        .herd-panel-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .herd-panel-title.active-title { color: var(--text-light); }

        /* Population grid of people icons */
        .population-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(3px, 0.5vw, 8px);
        }

        .person-icon {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        .person-head {
            width: clamp(10px, 1.8vw, 22px);
            height: clamp(10px, 1.8vw, 22px);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .person-body {
            width: clamp(8px, 1.4vw, 18px);
            height: clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 28px);
            border-radius: 4px 4px 6px 6px;
        }

        /* Person state colors */
        .p-vaccinated .person-head { background: #4ade80; }
        .p-vaccinated .person-body { background: #16a34a; }
        .p-unvaccinated .person-head { background: #fbbf24; }
        .p-unvaccinated .person-body { background: #d97706; }
        .p-vulnerable .person-head { background: #60a5fa; }
        .p-vulnerable .person-body { background: #2563eb; }
        .p-infected .person-head { background: #f87171; }
        .p-infected .person-body { background: #dc2626; }
        .p-protected .person-head { background: #60a5fa; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(96,165,250,0.6); }
        .p-protected .person-body { background: #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(37,99,235,0.6); }

        .herd-legend {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .legend-person {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
        }

        .legend-swatch {
            width: clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 16px);
            height: clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 16px);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: REMAINING CHALLENGES
           White background, partial data visualization
           =========================================== */
        .slide-challenges { background: var(--bg-secondary); }

        .challenges-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .challenge-bars {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1.2rem);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .challenge-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(100px, 16vw, 180px) 1fr clamp(50px, 6vw, 80px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }

        .ch-label {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .ch-track {
            background: var(--border);
            border-radius: 3px;
            height: clamp(16px, 2.8vh, 36px);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .ch-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            transition: width 1.0s var(--ease-out-expo);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding-left: clamp(4px, 0.6vw, 8px);
        }

        .ch-fill-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: white;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .ch-pct {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .ch-fill.complete { background: var(--data-green); }
        .ch-fill.high { background: #3d7a2c; }
        .ch-fill.medium { background: var(--data-amber); }
        .ch-fill.low { background: #cc4400; }

        .challenges-barriers {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .barrier-block {
            background: white;
            border-top: 4px solid var(--accent);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1.2rem);
            border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px;
        }

        .barrier-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 3px;
        }

        .barrier-desc {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: TAKEAWAYS & CALL TO ACTION
           Dark background, numbered key findings
           =========================================== */
        .slide-takeaways { background: var(--bg-panel); }

        .takeaways-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr auto;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .findings-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           Swiss Modern — keyboard + touch + scroll navigation
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.total = this.slides.length;
                this.current = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupMouseWheel();
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            /* Intersection Observer — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.current = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.6 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
                });
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.total) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            goTo(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'PageDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.current + 1);
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.current - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.total - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                let startX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    const threshold = 50;

                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > threshold) {
                        this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupMouseWheel() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    this.goTo(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }
        }

        /* Boot on DOM ready */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
            /* Trigger first slide immediately */
            document.querySelector('.slide')?.classList.add('visible');
        });

        /* Also trigger first slide in case DOMContentLoaded already fired */
        if (document.readyState !== 'loading') {
            document.querySelector('.slide')?.classList.add('visible');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

                    <h2 class="slide-title-text on-dark reveal">Vaccines Have Eliminated Deadly Diseases — But the Job Isn't Done</h2>
                    <div class="slide-rule reveal"></div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="findings-grid">
                <div class="finding-card reveal">
                    <span class="finding-num">01</span>
                    <div class="finding-text">
                        <strong>100% elimination achieved</strong>
                        Vaccines achieved 100% case and death reduction for diphtheria, smallpox, and both forms of polio in the US.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="finding-card reveal">
                    <span class="finding-num">02</span>
                    <div class="finding-text">
                        <strong>Development timelines collapsed</strong>
                        From 105 years (typhoid) to under 1 year (COVID-19), driven by mRNA technology and genomic tools.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="finding-card reveal">
                    <span class="finding-num">03</span>
                    <div class="finding-text">
                        <strong>Measles near-eliminated in the US</strong>
                        Cases dropped to near zero across all 50 states following the 1980 kindergarten vaccination mandate.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="finding-card reveal">
                    <span class="finding-num">04</span>
                    <div class="finding-text">
                        <strong>Herd immunity protects communities</strong>
                        High vaccination coverage shields newborns, immunocompromised patients, and those on chemotherapy.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="finding-card reveal">
                    <span class="finding-num">05</span>
                    <div class="finding-text">
                        <strong>Gaps persist — action required</strong>
                        Pneumococcal disease: 40.5% case reduction. Hepatitis A: 89%. Hepatitis B: 83.9%. Coverage must improve.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="finding-card reveal" style="border-color: rgba(204,34,0,0.3); background: rgba(204,34,0,0.06);">
                    <span class="finding-num" style="opacity: 1;">★</span>
                    <div class="finding-text">
                        <strong style="color: var(--accent-light);">Smallpox — the proof of concept</strong>
                        The only human disease eradicated through vaccination (certified 1980). A blueprint for future elimination.
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="cta-banner reveal">
                <div class="cta-text">
                    Improve access, coverage, and trust in vaccination — the tools exist; the commitment must follow.
                </div>
                <span class="cta-label">Call to Action</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           Swiss Modern — keyboard + touch + scroll navigation
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.total = this.slides.length;
                this.current = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupMouseWheel();
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            /* Intersection Observer — adds .visible to trigger CSS animations */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.current = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.6 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('button');
                    btn.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(btn);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
                });
            }

            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = ((idx + 1) / this.total) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            goTo(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (['ArrowDown', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'PageDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.current + 1);
                    } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowLeft', 'PageUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.current - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.total - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                let startX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    const threshold = 50;

                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > threshold) {
                        this.goTo(dy > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupMouseWheel() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    this.goTo(e.deltaY > 0 ? this.current + 1 : this.current - 1);
                }, { passive: true });
            }
        }

        /* Boot on DOM ready */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
            /* Trigger first slide immediately */
            document.querySelector('.slide')?.classList.add('visible');
        });

        /* Also trigger first slide in case DOMContentLoaded already fired */
        if (document.readyState !== 'loading') {
            document.querySelector('.slide')?.classList.add('visible');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
